name: Osceola Tug Hill XC Ski Center
description: In the heart of the Tug Hill Plateau, OTHXCSC offers over 100 acres of mature forestland for your skiing pleasure. Thanks to Great Lake Ontario offering over 200 inches of lake effect snow, Osceola is dependable for winter fun when others are starving for snow. Trails are groomed for classic and skate skiing. Snack bar, retail shop, rental equipment, ski repair and tuning, lessons, and trailside lodging on site.
